name: Fantasmi/Ghosts
source:
I've been keeping this coffee bar for years, and I've seen ghosts for even longer. One day, a dear old friend of mine sent me a letter. It reminded me of three meetings I had in the past. Three different ghosts, and the issues they hid within them.

[From [url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/fantasmighosts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我经营这家咖啡馆已有多年，而我见到鬼魂的时间更久。一天，一位亲爱的老友寄来一封信，让我想起过去的三次相遇：三只不同的鬼魂，以及它们各自藏着的问题。

[来源：[url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/fantasmighosts]Itch.io[/url]]
